# LinkETA — pip requirements (pinned)

# torch / torch_geometric / torch_sparse are built against a specific
# PyTorch + CUDA combo (here: PyTorch 2.5 + CUDA 11.8 => "+pt25cu118").
# The torch_sparse wheel is NOT on PyPI — install it from the PyG index:
#
#   pip install torch==2.5.1
#   pip install torch_geometric==2.7.0 torch_sparse==0.6.18 \
#       -f https://data.pyg.org/whl/torch-2.5.1+cu118.html
#
# For a CPU-only / different-CUDA machine, pick the matching index URL from
# https://data.pyg.org/whl/ and the matching torch build from
# https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/  (see env/SETUP.md).
#
# Install everything else with:  pip install -r env/requirements.txt
# (then run the torch trio commands above if the wheels below don't resolve).
